WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), shares AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share
  FROM circuit_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         share,
         share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) DESC) AS excess_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
  AND excess_rank <= 10
ORDER BY excess_share DESC;
